  select case f.profile_space

      where w.id = f.workspace_id and w.slug = f.profile_handle
        and coalesce((p.display_prefs->>'publicProfile')::boolean,true)
        and not coalesce(p.is_banned,false) and not coalesce(p.is_suspended,false)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.patch_workspace_profile_draft(p_workspace_id uuid, p_fields jsonb, p_prefs jsonb, p_drop_prefs text[])
 RETURNS TABLE(revision bigint, published_revision bigint, updated_at timestamp with time zone, published_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_fields jsonb := coalesce(p_fields, '{}'::jsonb);
  v_prefs jsonb := coalesce(p_prefs, '{}'::jsonb);
begin
  if jsonb_typeof(v_fields) <> 'object' or jsonb_typeof(v_prefs) <> 'object' then
    raise exception 'validation: draft patch must be an object';
  end if;

  return query
    update public.workspace_profile_drafts d
       set payload = (d.payload || (v_fields - 'displayPrefs' - 'username'))
             || jsonb_build_object(
               'displayPrefs',
               ((case when jsonb_typeof(d.payload -> 'displayPrefs') = 'object'
                      then d.payload -> 'displayPrefs' else '{}'::jsonb end)
                 - coalesce(p_drop_prefs, '{}'::text[]))
               || v_prefs
             ),
           revision = d.revision + 1,
           updated_by = public.rout_current_user_id(),
           updated_at = now()
     where d.workspace_id = p_workspace_id
    returning d.revision, d.published_revision, d.updated_at, d.published_at;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'draft_not_found';
  end if;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.publish_profile_draft(p_user_id uuid, p_space text, p_expected_revision bigint)
 RETURNS TABLE(revision bigint, published_revision bigint, published_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_payload jsonb;
  v_revision bigint;
begin
  select d.payload, d.revision into v_payload, v_revision
    from public.profile_drafts d
   where d.user_id = p_user_id and d.space = p_space
   for update;

  if v_payload is null or v_revision <> p_expected_revision then
    raise exception 'draft_conflict';
  end if;

  if p_space = 'verified' then
    update public.profiles set
      username = v_payload->>'username',
      display_name = nullif(v_payload->>'displayName', ''),
      tagline = nullif(v_payload->>'tagline', ''),
      avatar_url = nullif(v_payload->>'avatarUrl', ''),
      favicon_url = nullif(v_payload->>'faviconUrl', ''),
      theme = coalesce(nullif(v_payload->>'theme', ''), 'noir'),
      card_style = coalesce(nullif(v_payload->>'cardStyle', ''), 'bordered'),
      blocks = coalesce(v_payload->'blocks', '[]'::jsonb),
      display_prefs = coalesce(v_payload->'displayPrefs', '{}'::jsonb),
      updated_at = now()
    where id = p_user_id;
    if not found then raise exception 'profile_not_found'; end if;
  elsif p_space = 'alias' then
    update public.alias_profiles set
      handle = v_payload->>'username',
      display_name = nullif(v_payload->>'displayName', ''),
      tagline = nullif(v_payload->>'tagline', ''),
      avatar_url = nullif(v_payload->>'avatarUrl', ''),
      favicon_url = nullif(v_payload->>'faviconUrl', ''),
      theme = coalesce(nullif(v_payload->>'theme', ''), 'noir'),
      card_style = coalesce(nullif(v_payload->>'cardStyle', ''), 'bordered'),
      blocks = coalesce(v_payload->'blocks', '[]'::jsonb),
      display_prefs = coalesce(v_payload->'displayPrefs', '{}'::jsonb),
      updated_at = now()
    where user_id = p_user_id;
    if not found then raise exception 'profile_not_found'; end if;
  else
    raise exception 'draft_space_invalid';
  end if;

  update public.profile_drafts d
     set published_revision = d.revision, published_at = now(), updated_at = now()
   where d.user_id = p_user_id and d.space = p_space;

  return query
    select d.revision, d.published_revision, d.published_at
      from public.profile_drafts d
     where d.user_id = p_user_id and d.space = p_space;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.read_public_fediverse(p_user uuid)

 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select i.handle, i.verified, i.verified_at, i.verify_code,
    array(select distinct v from (
      select 'https://rout.be/@' || p.username as v
      union all select 'https://rout.be/' || p.username
      union all select 'https://' || case
        when p.subdomain_tier='root_lifetime' and p.root_subdomain_status='active' then p.username || '.rout.be'
        when p.subdomain_tier in ('root_lifetime','pro') then p.username || '.r.rout.be'
        else coalesce(p.subdomain_alias,p.username) || '.u.rout.be' end
        where p.subdomain_enabled
      union all select 'https://' || d.domain from public.custom_domains d where d.user_id=p.id and d.status='verified'
    ) destinations where v is not null order by v)
  from public.user_integrations i
  join public.profiles p on p.id=i.user_id
  join public.users u on u.id=p.id
  where i.user_id=p_user and i.provider='mastodon' and i.visible
    and i.verify_code like 'relme:%' and u.email_confirmed_at is not null
    and p.username is not null and coalesce(p.is_banned,false)=false
    and coalesce(p.is_suspended,false)=false
    and coalesce(p.status,'active') not in ('frozen','banned','suspended')
    and coalesce((p.display_prefs->>'publicProfile')::boolean,true)
  limit 1
$function$

 RETURNS integer

 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare uid uuid := public.rout_current_user_id(); n integer := 0;
begin
  if uid is null then return 0; end if;
  with inv as (
    update public.workspace_invites set status = 'accepted'
    where status = 'pending'
      and (invited_user_id = uid or (coalesce(p_email, '') <> '' and invited_user_id is null and lower(email) = lower(p_email)))

  on conflict do nothing;
  get diagnostics n = row_count;
  return n;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rout_agent_sandbox_patch_draft(p_key_hash text, p_fields jsonb, p_prefs jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(revision bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare v_ws uuid;
begin
  if jsonb_typeof(p_fields) <> 'object' or jsonb_typeof(p_prefs) <> 'object' then
    raise exception 'validation: draft patch must be an object';
  end if;
  select s.workspace_id into v_ws from public.agent_sandboxes s
    join public.agent_workspace_claims c on c.workspace_id = s.workspace_id and c.claimed_at is null
   where s.key_hash = p_key_hash and s.revoked_at is null and s.expires_at > now();
  if v_ws is null then raise exception 'sandbox_invalid'; end if;
  return query
    update public.workspace_profile_drafts d
       set payload = (d.payload || (p_fields - 'displayPrefs' - 'username' - 'avatarUrl' - 'faviconUrl'))
             || jsonb_build_object('displayPrefs',
                  (case when jsonb_typeof(d.payload -> 'displayPrefs') = 'object' then d.payload -> 'displayPrefs' else '{}'::jsonb end)
                  || p_prefs),
           revision = d.revision + 1,
           updated_at = now()
     where d.workspace_id = v_ws
    returning d.revision;
end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rout_alias_job_finish(p_id uuid, p_status text, p_attempts integer, p_error text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if p_status not in ('done', 'failed', 'pending') or p_attempts is null or p_attempts not between 0 and 100
     or coalesce(pg_catalog.length(p_error), 0) > 2000 then
    raise exception 'invalid alias job result' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  update public.alias_sync_jobs j
     set status = p_status, attempts = p_attempts, last_error = case when p_status = 'done' then null else p_error end,
         updated_at = pg_catalog.now()
   where j.id = p_id and j.status = 'pending';
  return found;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rout_audit_search(p_admin_email text, p_action text, p_actions text[], p_search text, p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone, p_cursor_at timestamp with time zone, p_cursor_id uuid, p_offset integer, p_limit integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, admin_email text, action text, target_user_id uuid, target_label text, notes text, created_at timestamp with time zone, total bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.rout_is_admin_member(public.rout_current_user_id()) then
    raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  return query
    select a.id, a.admin_email, a.action, a.target_user_id, a.target_label, a.notes, a.created_at,
           count(*) over ()
      from public.admin_audit_log a
     where (nullif(p_admin_email, '') is null or a.admin_email ilike public.rout_like_literal(p_admin_email))
       and (nullif(p_action, '') is null or a.action = p_action)
       and (p_actions is null or a.action = any (p_actions))
       and (nullif(p_search, '') is null
            or a.action ilike public.rout_like_literal(p_search)
            or a.admin_email ilike public.rout_like_literal(p_search)
            or a.target_label ilike public.rout_like_literal(p_search)
            or a.notes ilike public.rout_like_literal(p_search))
       and (p_from is null or a.created_at >= p_from)
       and (p_to is null or a.created_at <= p_to)
       and (p_cursor_at is null or a.created_at < p_cursor_at
            or (a.created_at = p_cursor_at and a.id < p_cursor_id))
     order by a.created_at desc, a.id desc
     offset greatest(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 0)
     limit least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 20), 1), 1000);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rout_audit_write(p_event_type text, p_user text, p_actor text, p_ip_hash text, p_ua_hash text, p_payload jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if p_event_type is null or p_event_type !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,80}$'
     or coalesce(pg_catalog.length(p_user), 0) > 80 or coalesce(pg_catalog.length(p_actor), 0) > 80
     or (p_ip_hash is not null and p_ip_hash !~ '^[0-9a-f]{1,64}$')
     or (p_ua_hash is not null and p_ua_hash !~ '^[0-9a-f]{1,64}$')
     or pg_catalog.octet_length(coalesce(p_payload, '{}'::jsonb)::text) > 16384 then
    raise exception 'invalid audit entry' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  insert into public.security_audit_logs (event_type, user_id, actor_id, ip_hash, user_agent_hash, payload_json, prev_hash, current_hash)
  values (p_event_type, p_user, p_actor, p_ip_hash, p_ua_hash, coalesce(p_payload, '{}'::jsonb), '', '');
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rout_availability_claim_due(p_limit integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, attempts integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if p_limit is null or p_limit not between 1 and 100 then
    raise exception 'invalid limit' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  return query
    delete from public.availability_jobs j where j.user_id in (
      select d.user_id from public.availability_jobs d where d.run_after <= pg_catalog.now()
       order by d.run_after limit p_limit for update skip locked)
    returning j.user_id, j.attempts;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rout_availability_enqueue(p_user uuid, p_reason text, p_delay_seconds integer DEFAULT 0, p_replace_reason boolean DEFAULT true)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if p_user is null or p_reason is null or p_reason !~ '^[a-z_]{1,40}$'
     or p_delay_seconds is null or p_delay_seconds not between 0 and 86400 then
    raise exception 'invalid availability job' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  insert into public.availability_jobs (user_id, reason, run_after)
  values (p_user, p_reason, pg_catalog.now() + pg_catalog.make_interval(secs => p_delay_seconds))
  on conflict (user_id) do update
    set reason = case when p_replace_reason then excluded.reason else public.availability_jobs.reason end,
        run_after = least(public.availability_jobs.run_after, excluded.run_after);
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rout_availability_retry(p_user uuid, p_attempts integer)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if p_user is null or p_attempts is null or p_attempts < 0 or p_attempts >= 5 then return false; end if;
  insert into public.availability_jobs (user_id, reason, run_after, attempts)
  values (p_user, 'retry', pg_catalog.now() + pg_catalog.make_interval(mins => (2 ^ p_attempts)::int), p_attempts + 1)
  on conflict (user_id) do nothing;
  return found;
end $function$

 RETURNS jsonb

 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare ids uuid[] := public.rout_booking_group_ids(p_booking); st text; hs uuid[];
begin
  with u as (
    update public.bookings b set
      status = case when t.confirmation_mode = 'request' then 'requested' else 'confirmed' end,
      hold_expires_at = null, updated_at = now()
    from public.booking_event_types t
    where b.id = any(ids) and t.id = b.event_type_id and b.status = 'pending_payment'
      and exists (select 1 from public.bookings s where s.id = p_booking and s.stripe_checkout_session_id = p_session)
    returning b.status, b.host_user_id)
  select max(status), array_agg(host_user_id) into st, hs from u;
  return jsonb_build_object('status', coalesce(st, 'noop'), 'hostIds', coalesce(to_jsonb(hs), '[]'::jsonb), 'bookingId', p_booking);
end $function$

 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select public.rout_booking_cache_free(p_host, p_block_start, p_block_end)
    and not exists (
      select 1 from public.bookings b where b.host_user_id = p_host
        and b.status in ('held','pending_payment','requested','confirmed')
        and tstzrange(b.block_start_utc, b.block_end_utc, '[)') && tstzrange(p_block_start, p_block_end, '[)')
        and not (p_capacity > 1 and b.shared_slot and b.event_type_id = p_event_type and b.start_utc = p_start))
    and (p_capacity <= 1 or (select count(*) from public.bookings b where b.host_user_id = p_host and b.shared_slot
        and b.event_type_id = p_event_type and b.start_utc = p_start
        and b.status in ('held','pending_payment','requested','confirmed')) < p_capacity)
    and not exists (
      select 1 from public.calendar_events ev join public.connected_calendars c on c.id = ev.calendar_id
      where c.user_id = p_host and ev.is_blocking and ev.start_utc < p_block_end and ev.end_utc > p_block_start)

functions.args: p_id uuid, p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone, p_hold uuid

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rout_booking_public_sessions(p_id uuid, p_from timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone, p_hold uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(host_ordinal integer, start_utc timestamp with time zone, block_start_utc timestamp with time zone, block_end_utc timestamp with time zone, open boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare cap integer;
begin
  if not public.rout_booking_type_public(p_id) then return; end if;
  select greatest(1, t.resource_capacity) into cap from public.booking_event_types t where t.id = p_id;
  if p_to > p_from + interval '400 days' then p_to := p_from + interval '400 days'; end if;
  return query
    with hosts as (
      select h.user_id, row_number() over (order by h.user_id)::integer as ord
      from public.booking_event_type_hosts h where h.event_type_id = p_id
    ), seats as (
      select b.host_user_id as host, b.event_type_id as et, b.start_utc as s, b.block_start_utc as bs, b.block_end_utc as be
      from public.bookings b join hosts on hosts.user_id = b.host_user_id
      where b.shared_slot and b.status in ('held','pending_payment','requested','confirmed')
        and b.block_end_utc > p_from and b.block_start_utc < p_to
      union all
      select x.host_user_id, x.event_type_id, x.start_utc, x.block_start_utc, x.block_end_utc
      from public.booking_holds x join hosts on hosts.user_id = x.host_user_id
      where x.shared_slot and x.expires_at > now() and x.hold_id is distinct from p_hold
        and x.block_end_utc > p_from and x.block_start_utc < p_to
    )
    select hosts.ord, g.s, min(g.bs), max(g.be), (g.et = p_id and cap > 1 and count(*) < cap)
    from seats g join hosts on hosts.user_id = g.host
    group by hosts.ord, g.host, g.et, g.s;
end $function$

declare n integer;
begin
  with u as (
    update public.bookings set status = 'cancelled', hold_expires_at = null, updated_at = now()
    where id = any(public.rout_booking_group_ids(p_booking)) and status in ('held','pending_payment')
    returning host_user_id),
  j as (
    insert into public.availability_jobs (user_id, reason) select distinct host_user_id, 'hold_released' from u
    on conflict (user_id) do update set run_after = least(public.availability_jobs.run_after, now())
    returning 1)
  select count(*) into n from u;
  return n;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rout_booking_request_create(p_profile uuid, p_guest_name text, p_guest_email text, p_date date, p_time text, p_message text, p_duration integer, p_title text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare v_id uuid;
begin
  if p_profile is null or p_guest_name is null or pg_catalog.length(p_guest_name) not between 2 and 120
     or p_guest_email is null or pg_catalog.length(p_guest_email) not between 3 and 254 or pg_catalog.strpos(p_guest_email, '@') = 0
     or p_date is null or p_time is null or p_time !~ '^[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}$'
     or coalesce(pg_catalog.length(p_message), 0) > 500
     or p_duration is null or p_duration not between 5 and 1440
     or coalesce(pg_catalog.length(p_title), 0) > 200 then
    raise exception 'invalid booking request' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  if not exists (
    select 1 from public.profiles p
     cross join lateral pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(case when pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(p.blocks) = 'array' then p.blocks else '[]'::jsonb end) b(el)
     where p.id = p_profile and b.el->>'kind' = 'booking_request'
       and coalesce(b.el->'hidden', 'false'::jsonb) <> 'true'::jsonb) then
    raise exception 'no booking form' using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;
  insert into public.booking_requests (profile_id, guest_name, guest_email, preferred_date, preferred_time,
    guest_message, duration_minutes, title)
  values (p_profile, p_guest_name, p_guest_email, p_date, p_time, p_message, p_duration, p_title)
  returning id into v_id;
  return v_id;
end $function$

       set status = case when p_action = 'accept' then 'accepted' else 'declined' end, updated_at = pg_catalog.now()
     where r.id = p_id and r.status = 'pending'
    returning r.id, r.profile_id, r.guest_name, r.guest_email, r.preferred_date, r.preferred_time,
              r.guest_message, r.duration_minutes, r.title;

 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'

declare v_id uuid;
begin
  if p_name is null or pg_catalog.length(p_name) not between 1 and 100
     or p_email is null or pg_catalog.length(p_email) not between 3 and 255 or pg_catalog.strpos(p_email, '@') = 0
     or p_subject is null or pg_catalog.length(p_subject) not between 1 and 150
     or p_message is null or pg_catalog.length(p_message) not between 1 and 2000
     or p_locale not in ('nl', 'en', 'fr', 'de')
     or coalesce(pg_catalog.length(p_sender_hash), 0) > 128

     or coalesce(pg_catalog.length(p_category), 0) > 40
     or coalesce(pg_catalog.length(p_priority), 0) > 40

 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, expires_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if p_primary is null or p_pin_hash !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9+/]{43}=$' or p_token_hash !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9+/]{43}=$'
     or p_pin_hash = p_token_hash or p_ttl_minutes is null or p_ttl_minutes not between 1 and 60 then
    raise exception 'invalid ticket' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  update public.account_merge_tickets t set used_at = pg_catalog.now() where t.primary_user_id = p_primary and t.used_at is null;
  return query
    insert into public.account_merge_tickets as t (primary_user_id, pin_hash, token_hash, expires_at)
    values (p_primary, p_pin_hash, p_token_hash, pg_catalog.now() + pg_catalog.make_interval(mins => p_ttl_minutes))
    returning t.id, t.expires_at;
end $function$

 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  update public.oauth_access_tokens t set revoked_at = coalesce(t.revoked_at, now())
   where t.token_hash = p_hash and t.client_id = p_client;
  update public.oauth_refresh_tokens r set revoked_at = coalesce(r.revoked_at, now())
   where r.client_id = p_client and r.family_id in (select f.family_id from public.oauth_refresh_tokens f
                                                    where f.token_hash = p_hash and f.client_id = p_client);
  update public.oauth_access_tokens t set revoked_at = coalesce(t.revoked_at, now())
   where t.client_id = p_client and t.family_id in (select f.family_id from public.oauth_refresh_tokens f

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rout_physical_key_audit()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if tg_op = 'INSERT' then
    insert into public.physical_key_events (hardware_id, user_id, event) values (new.hardware_id, new.user_id, 'provisioned');
  elsif new.status is distinct from old.status then
    insert into public.physical_key_events (hardware_id, user_id, event) values (
      new.hardware_id, new.user_id,
      case new.status when 'active' then (case old.status when 'frozen' then 'unfrozen' else 'activated' end)
                      when 'frozen' then 'frozen' else 'revoked' end);
  end if;
  -- A revoked key never comes back.
  if tg_op = 'UPDATE' and old.status = 'revoked' and new.status <> 'revoked' then
    raise exception 'revoked keys cannot be reactivated' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rout_presence_public(p_handle text, p_space text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare o record; blocks jsonb; result jsonb;
begin
 select * into o from public.rout_qa_owner(p_handle,p_space);
 if o.owner_id is null then return '[]'::jsonb; end if;
 if p_space='alias' then select a.blocks into blocks from public.alias_profiles a where a.user_id=o.owner_id;
 else select p.blocks into blocks from public.profiles p where p.id=o.owner_id; end if;
 select coalesce(jsonb_agg(s.data order by s.at),'[]'::jsonb) into result from (
  select q.answered_at as at,jsonb_build_object('id',q.id,'statusType','qa_reply','question',q.body,'answer',q.answer,'createdAt',q.answered_at,'expiresAt',q.story_until) as data
  from public.profile_questions q where q.owner_id=o.owner_id and q.space=p_space and q.published
   and q.answer is not null and not q.is_quarantined and q.story_until>now()
  union all
  select e.created_at,jsonb_build_object('id',e.id,'statusType','micro_text','text',e.content_payload->>'text','theme',coalesce(e.content_payload->>'theme','aurora'),'bg',e.content_payload->>'bg','font',e.content_payload->>'font','align',e.content_payload->>'align','sticker',e.content_payload->>'sticker','createdAt',e.created_at,'expiresAt',e.expires_at)
  from public.ephemeral_statuses e where e.user_id=o.owner_id and e.space=p_space and e.status_type='micro_text' and e.expires_at>now()
  union all
  select e.created_at,jsonb_build_object('id',e.id,'statusType','omni_drop','blockId',b->>'id','title',coalesce(i->>'caption',b->>'label'),'targetUrl',coalesce(i->>'targetUrl',b->>'value'),'mediaUrl',coalesce(i->>'mediaUrl',b->>'thumbnailUrl'),'badge',b->>'badge','createdAt',e.created_at,'expiresAt',e.expires_at)
  from public.ephemeral_statuses e
  cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(blocks,'[]'::jsonb)) b
  left join lateral jsonb_array_elements(case when b->>'kind'='social_grid' then coalesce((b->>'value')::jsonb->'items','[]'::jsonb) else '[]'::jsonb end) i on i->>'id'=e.content_payload->>'itemId'
  where e.user_id=o.owner_id and e.space=p_space and e.status_type='omni_drop' and e.expires_at>now()
   and b->>'id'=e.content_payload->>'blockId' and coalesce((b->>'hidden')::boolean,false)=false
   and (nullif(b->>'startsAt','') is null or (b->>'startsAt')::timestamptz<=now())
   and (nullif(b->>'expiresAt','') is null or (b->>'expiresAt')::timestamptz>now())
   and (not(e.content_payload ? 'itemId') or i is not null)
  order by at desc limit 30
 ) s;
 return result;
end $function$

functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rout_prune_avatar_uploads(p_prefix text, p_keep integer)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_caller uuid := public.rout_current_user_id();
  v_deleted integer := 0;
begin
  if v_caller is null or p_prefix is null or p_prefix not in ('avatar', 'workspace-logo')
     or p_keep is null or p_keep < 1 or p_keep > 20 then
    return 0;
  end if;

  with mine as (
    select a.path, row_number() over (order by a.created_at desc, a.path desc) as rn
      from public.avatar_objects a
     where a.user_id = v_caller
       and pg_catalog.starts_with(a.path, v_caller::text || '/' || p_prefix || '-')
  ), doomed as (
    select m.path, pg_catalog.replace(m.path, '/', '%2F') as enc
      from mine m
     where m.rn > p_keep
  ), unused as (
    select d.path from doomed d
     where not exists (select 1 from public.profiles p
             where pg_catalog.strpos(coalesce(p.avatar_url, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.favicon_url, ''), d.path) > 0
                or pg_catalog.strpos(coalesce(p.avatar_url, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.favicon_url, ''), d.enc) > 0)
       and not exists (select 1 from public.alias_profiles ap
             where pg_catalog.strpos(coalesce(ap.avatar_url, '') || ' ' || coalesce(ap.favicon_url, ''), d.path) > 0
                or pg_catalog.strpos(coalesce(ap.avatar_url, '') || ' ' || coalesce(ap.favicon_url, ''), d.enc) > 0)
       and not exists (select 1 from public.profile_drafts pd
             where pg_catalog.strpos(pd.payload::text, d.path) > 0 or pg_catalog.strpos(pd.payload::text, d.enc) > 0)
       and not exists (select 1 from public.workspaces w
             where pg_catalog.strpos(coalesce(w.avatar_url, '') || ' ' || coalesce(w.public_profile::text, ''), d.path) > 0
                or pg_catalog.strpos(coalesce(w.avatar_url, '') || ' ' || coalesce(w.public_profile::text, ''), d.enc) > 0)
       and not exists (select 1 from public.workspace_profile_drafts wd
             where pg_catalog.strpos(wd.payload::text, d.path) > 0 or pg_catalog.strpos(wd.payload::text, d.enc) > 0)
       and not exists (select 1 from public.oauth_clients oc
             where pg_catalog.strpos(coalesce(oc.logo_url, ''), d.path) > 0 or pg_catalog.strpos(coalesce(oc.logo_url, ''), d.enc) > 0)
  ), gone as (
    delete from public.avatar_objects a
     using unused u
     where a.path = u.path and a.user_id = v_caller
    returning 1
  )
  select count(*)::integer into v_deleted from gone;
  return v_deleted;
end $function$

AS $function$
declare o record; v_show boolean;
begin
  select * into o from public.rout_qa_owner(p_handle, p_space);
  if o.owner_id is null then return null; end if;
  v_show := coalesce((o.prefs->>'qaShowAvatar')::boolean, true);
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'accepting', coalesce((o.prefs->>'questionsEnabled')::boolean, false),
    'onHub', coalesce((o.prefs->>'qaOnHub')::boolean, true),
    'page', coalesce((o.prefs->>'qaPage')::boolean, false),
    'promptKey', o.prefs->>'qaPrompt', 'promptCustom', o.prefs->>'qaPromptCustom',
    'displayName', o.display_name,
    'avatarUrl', case when v_show then o.avatar_url end,
    'audience', coalesce(o.prefs->>'qaAudience', 'members_only'),
    'showAvatar', v_show,
    'showProfileLink', coalesce((o.prefs->>'qaShowProfileLink')::boolean, true),
    'design', (select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(key, value), '{}'::jsonb)
      from jsonb_each(coalesce(o.prefs, '{}'::jsonb))
      where key in ('themeOverrides', 'buttonVariant', 'buttonRadius', 'buttonColor',
        'buttonTextColor', 'buttonSize', 'fontPairing', 'buttonsCustom', 'typographyCustom',
        'glassStyle', 'glassOpacity', 'glassBlur', 'glassBorder', 'glassTargets')),
    'qaLevel', (select to_jsonb(u)->>'qa_permission_level' from public.users u where u.id=o.owner_id),
    'answers', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'id',q.id,'body',q.body,'answer',q.answer,'prompt',q.prompt,
      'answeredAt',q.answered_at,'storyUntil',q.story_until) order by q.answered_at desc)
      from (select id,body,answer,prompt,answered_at,story_until from public.profile_questions
        where owner_id=o.owner_id and space=p_space and published and answer is not null
          and not is_quarantined order by answered_at desc limit 30) q), '[]'::jsonb)
  );

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rout_sepa_review_queue(p_payment uuid, p_user uuid, p_reason text, p_reference text, p_amount integer, p_expected integer, p_payer_name text, p_holder_name text, p_match_score numeric, p_notes text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare v uuid;
begin
  if coalesce(p_reason, 'name_mismatch') !~ '^[a-z_]{1,40}$' or coalesce(pg_catalog.length(p_reference), 0) > 80
     or coalesce(pg_catalog.length(p_payer_name), 0) > 300 or coalesce(pg_catalog.length(p_holder_name), 0) > 300
     or coalesce(pg_catalog.length(p_notes), 0) > 2000 then
    raise exception 'invalid review' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  insert into public.sepa_review_queue as q
    (payment_id, user_id, reason, reference, amount_cents, expected_cents, payer_name, holder_name, match_score, notes)
  values (p_payment, p_user, coalesce(p_reason, 'name_mismatch'), p_reference, p_amount, p_expected,
          p_payer_name, p_holder_name, p_match_score, p_notes)
  on conflict (payment_id) where status = 'open' and payment_id is not null
  do update set reference = coalesce(excluded.reference, q.reference), amount_cents = excluded.amount_cents,
                payer_name = coalesce(excluded.payer_name, q.payer_name), match_score = excluded.match_score
  returning q.id into v;
  return v;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rout_webhook_delivery_result(p_id uuid, p_http_status integer, p_outcome text, p_delay_sec integer)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare v int;
begin
  if p_outcome not in ('delivered', 'retry', 'failed')
     or (p_outcome = 'retry' and (p_delay_sec is null or p_delay_sec not between 1 and 604800)) then
    raise exception 'invalid delivery result' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  update public.webhook_deliveries
     set attempts = attempts + 1, last_status = p_http_status,
         delivered_at = case when p_outcome = 'delivered' then pg_catalog.now() else delivered_at end,
         failed_at = case when p_outcome = 'failed' then pg_catalog.now() else failed_at end,
         next_attempt_at = case when p_outcome = 'retry' then pg_catalog.now() + pg_catalog.make_interval(secs => p_delay_sec)
                                else next_attempt_at end
   where id = p_id and delivered_at is null and failed_at is null
  returning attempts into v;
  return v;
end $function$

 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if p_status not in ('done', 'failed') then raise exception 'invalid webhook status' using errcode = '22023'; end if;
  update public.webhook_events
     set status = p_status, result = pg_catalog.left(p_result, 500), error = pg_catalog.left(p_error, 500),
         http_status = p_http_status, direction = 'inbound',
         completed_at = case when p_status = 'done' then pg_catalog.now() else completed_at end,
         updated_at = pg_catalog.now()
   where id = p_id and status = 'processing';
  return found;
end $function$

 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
begin
  if p_id is null or p_id !~ '^(outbound|inbound):[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,200}$' or p_source !~ '^[a-z0-9_-]{1,40}$'
     or coalesce(pg_catalog.length(p_kind), 0) > 120 or p_direction not in ('inbound', 'outbound')
     or p_status not in ('processing', 'done', 'failed') then
    raise exception 'invalid webhook event' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  insert into public.webhook_events (id, source, kind, direction, http_status, status, completed_at)
  values (p_id, p_source, p_kind, p_direction, p_http_status, p_status,
          case when p_status = 'processing' then null else pg_catalog.now() end)

  return found;
end $function$

     and not exists (select 1 from vault_enclave.sdm_batches b where b.sdm_ref = p_ref)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vault_enclave.server_keys_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
begin
  if tg_op = 'DELETE' then raise exception 'vault_enclave.server_keys is append-only'; end if;
  if old.retired_at is not null or new.retired_at is null
     or (new.kid, new.public_key, new.wrapped_seed, new.kek_id, new.created_at)
        is distinct from (old.kid, old.public_key, old.wrapped_seed, old.kek_id, old.created_at) then
    raise exception 'vault_enclave.server_keys rows can only be retired once';
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$
